title: adam Packet
description: Validates the structured front matter and required sections of a PACKET.md

orchestration.description: Autonomy toggles for the adam loop. Defaults favor set-and-forget; opt in to mid-run gates.

require_plan_approval.description: If true, research-and-plan waits for operator go/no-go before slice-to-tasks. Default false.

require_intake_grilling.description: If false, skip intake grilling (hotfix only). Default true — required upfront session with operator.

e2e.description: Committed Playwright E2E + orchestrator acceptance; drives tests-first / e2e-acceptance / review-runtime

spec_dir.description: Directory for Playwright specs, e.g. e2e/

dev.description: Start app for local E2E, e.g. pnpm dev

test.description: Run full Playwright suite, e.g. pnpm exec playwright test

base_url_env.description: Env var for base URL, e.g. PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL

default_base_url.description: Fallback base URL when env is unset, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3000

journeys.description: Maps success criteria to specs and MCP walk hints

operator_only.description: If true, do not auto-pass via agents; list under Outstanding manual checks

security.description: Security program metadata for audits, acceptance gate, and planning agents. Automated checks live in verification.layers security ids.

in_scope_services.description: Ecosystem repo ids when this packet spans multiple services

acceptance_required.description: If true, security-acceptance must pass before ship

block_ship_on.description: Open audit severities that fail security-acceptance (default critical + high)

verification.description: Optional multi-layer verification: UI (Playwright) vs API, integration stack, contracts, agentic QA, security tooling. Playwright MCP covers browser depth; FastAPI/services use pytest/API/scenario tests — not Playwright.

id.description: ui_e2e: browser; api_e2e: pytest+httpx/TestClient; integration: docker/local stack; contract: OpenAPI/Pydantic; agentic_qa: orchestrator-led QA; dependency_audit: npm audit/pip-audit; sast: bandit/semgrep; secret_scan: gitleaks; authz_review: route/auth matrix + regression tests; security_headers: CSP/HSTS checks

test_command.description: Shell command for e2e-acceptance to run from repo root (omit for agentic-only layers)

tools.description: e.g. pytest, httpx, docker compose, ruff, mypy

operator_only.description: If true, do not auto-pass; list under Outstanding manual checks

docs_or_prompt_ref.description: Repo-relative path to QA prompt, scenario list, or runbook
